ALEX MORGAN
San Francisco, CA | (555) 019-2834 | alex.morgan@email.com | linkedin.com/in/alexmorgan-ds
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Analytical and curious Data Scientist with over 4 years of industry experience bridging the gap between complex
data and strategic business choices. Expert in extracting insights from massive datasets, building robust predictive
machine learning models, and designing custom automation algorithms. Proven track record of translating complex
technical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for executive leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
TECHNICAL COMPETENCIES
Programming & Databases: Python, R, SQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB
Machine Learning & AI: Scikit-Learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Regression, Classification, Clustering, Decision
Trees
Mathematics & Statistics: Hypothesis Testing, Probability Distributions, Linear Algebra, Regression Analysis
Data Visualization: Tableau, PowerBI, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Plotly
Big Data & Cloud: Hadoop, Apache Spark, AWS (S3, EC2, SageMaker), GCP, Azure, Git
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Data Scientist | Innovate Tech Solutions, San Francisco, CA 2023 – Present
(cid:127) Data Processing & Cleaning: Mined, cleaned, and aggregated over 5TB of structured and unstructured user behavior
data from APIs, production databases, and web scraping pipelines, increasing data pipeline integrity and efficiency by
25%.
(cid:127) Predictive Modeling: Designed, tested, and scaled predictive machine learning models (including multi-class
classification and decision trees) to solve critical user retention problems, reducing customer churn by 14%.
(cid:127) Experimentation Frameworks: Established rigorous automated A/B testing frameworks to measure the business
performance of deployed algorithms and new product features, coordinating directly with product managers.
(cid:127) Visualization & Reporting: Built automated, interactive Tableau dashboards to present analytical narratives and
complex statistical insights cleanly to non-technical stakeholders and executive leadership.
(cid:127) Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partnered with data engineering teams to transition proof-of-concept Python models
into production-ready cloud workflows on AWS infrastructure.
Data Analyst / Junior Data Scientist | Quantum Analytics Corp, Boston, MA 2021 – 2023
(cid:127) Exploratory Data Analysis: Performed detailed exploratory analyses (EDA) on large-scale datasets using SQL,
Matplotlib, and Seaborn to uncover hidden operational patterns, identifying $120K in annualized cost-saving
opportunities.
(cid:127) Statistical Frameworks: Conducted advanced statistical analysis, utilizing hypothesis testing and probability
distributions to validate core underlying business assumptions and algorithm choices.
(cid:127) Model Development: Developed linear and logistic regression models to optimize marketing campaign allocation,
boosting acquisition efficiency by 18%.
(cid:127) Big Data Frameworks: Leveraged Apache Spark and Hadoop ecosystem to process and manipulate high-velocity
stream data from distributed databases.
EDUCATION
Master of Science in Statistics | Boston University, Boston, MA 2021
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science | University of California, Berkeley, CA 2019
